source.title: WCA Communication Team Leader Announcement (December 2025)
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

We are happy to announce that Kyle Kayden Hayles will become the new Leader of the WCA Communication Team (WCT). Kyle was already working as a Member of the WCT.

<!-- break -->

Kyle was selected by the WCA Board and approved in a vote, as described in Section 5 of our [Motion](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2025.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf) about WCA Committees and Teams. This appointment is effective as of December 18th, 2025.

We thank Zain Ali Behzaad, who will remain as a Senior Member of WCT, for the work he has done as the leader, and wish Kyle the best of luck in fulfilling his new duties.

Kyle was the only applicant for the role, and his successful candidacy document can be found [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1HNB3F9rn7GIQ9kW1NA0MJ15BAIPVMiym?usp=drive_link).

translation.title: WCA 沟通团队负责人任命公告（2025 年 12 月）
translation.content:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

我们很高兴地宣布，Kyle Kayden Hayles 将成为 WCA 沟通团队（WCT）的新负责人。Kyle 此前已是 WCT 成员。

按照 WCA 委员会与团队[动议](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2025.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)第 5 节的规定，WCA 董事会选定 Kyle，并投票通过了这一任命。任命自 2025 年 12 月 18 日起生效。

感谢 Zain Ali Behzaad 担任负责人期间所做的工作。他将继续担任 WCT 高级成员。祝 Kyle 在新的岗位上工作顺利。

Kyle 是这一职位的唯一申请者。他的申请材料可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1HNB3F9rn7GIQ9kW1NA0MJ15BAIPVMiym?usp=drive_link)查看。
